subject: Energy
title: Energy Democracy
description: A short lesson to help you apply Energy Democracy.

hook.text: Energy democracy gives communities ownership of their energy systems—from generation to pricing decisions.

buildup.text: Germany has 900+ energy cooperatives—citizen-owned solar and wind projects that share profits with local residents.

discovery.text: Community ownership builds public support for renewables—people welcome projects when they benefit directly from them.

twist.text: Large corporate developers often displace community projects—their scale and capital access can overwhelm local efforts.

climax.text: Community benefit agreements ensure locals share in revenues—jobs, reduced bills, or direct payments from projects.

punchline.text: Own the panels, share the power—energy democracy works.

quiz.question: How many energy cooperatives does Germany have?
